systems.system: SHANA, the eThekwini Municipality Water Data Exchange
systems.platform: a cloud-based data lake built with AWS
systems.tiers: one metropolitan municipality: water and sanitation officials and the revenue management department

note: AWS's own study of its Cape Town region. Its one local government item is SHANA, a cloud data lake eThekwini officials use for water data: a system one municipality works in, so an application, with nothing said of how the municipal offices are connected. GovChat is described as a national citizen-engagement platform with no local government named.
